content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Commercial laundry equipment for laundromats and hotels, a different product and customer set from onsite power systems."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Asphalt, aggregate and mining equipment for road builders and quarries, not onsite power generation."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Utility meters, filtration and aerospace components; its power-related work is testing, not onsite generation."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Electrical contracting and building installation services, a construction business rather than equipment manufacturing for onsite power."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Smart meters and utility software sold to utilities, a metering business rather than onsite generation equipment."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves, friction parts and connectors for industrial customers, not power generation systems."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Closest peer: gas-fueled engines and generator sets for onsite power, though it sells mainly to equipment makers rather than end power users."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Centrifugal and positive displacement pumps for water, fire and construction customers, a different product line."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Industrial heat tracing and process heating for plant operators; shares oil and gas customers but not onsite power equipment."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Semiconductor and LED deposition and etch tools sold to chip makers, a different business despite similar service model."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Coding and marking printers and water quality instruments, unrelated to microturbine power systems."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Network test equipment, optical components and software for telecom operators, not power generation."}]}
